changes.name: Postman（ブログ）
changes.diff_text:
+How Postman Passport keeps API secrets inside your network
+Talia Kohan
+Postman Passport grants API access using credential references, keeping the real secret inside your network. Here’s how the architecture works.
+Read more →
-Loops and beads: orchestrating AI agents with Postman
-Quinton Wall
-Compare two agent orchestration patterns, loops and beads, by building a Postman API health check agent in Python you can clone and run today.
-Read more →
changes.summary: 新機能「Postman Passport」のアーキテクチャに関する記事が公開されました。実際の秘密情報を社内ネットワーク内に保持したまま、認証情報のリファレンスを用いて安全にAPIアクセスを許可する仕組みが解説されています。

+We’re making updates to Claude Fable 5’s biology safeguards in a way that substantially reduces false positives. Fable 5 users will now experience many fewer “fallbacks”—where the system switches to a less capable model after they make a biology-related query.
